| Hurricane **Matthew** | 2016 | Category 2 at closest approach, later bottom‑of‑trough Hurricane | ~10–12 nm | **> 25 in** (e.g., 26 in. at McClellanville, SC and 27 in. at Johns Island; 23 in. at Bucklin, TN) | NHC best‑track data for Matthew showing eye ≈ 10–12 nm from Myrtle Beach [21†L1-L5], NWS Wilmington post‑event rainfall summary [4†L120-L134] |
